title: You’re not being punished…
paragraphs:
You’re not being punished…
You’re being pursued.
And that feeling you’ve been trying to ignore?

You keep distracting yourself.
Scrolling. Laughing. Numbing.
But the moment it gets quiet…

That weight.
That conviction.
That uncomfortable awareness that something is not right between you and God.
And you don’t want to face it.
But you also can’t escape it.

You know what you’ve been hiding.
You know what you’ve been excusing.
You know what you said you’d stop… but didn’t.
It doesn’t feel the same anymore.
That sin you used to enjoy…
Now it leaves a bitter aftertaste.
Now it convicts you before you even finish it.
Is starting to collapse under its own weight.
This is God getting your attention.
Because God loves you too much to let you stay numb.
“Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.” — Revelation 3:19
Some people sin and feel nothing.

No conviction.
No resistance.
No internal war.
Because God hasn’t let you go.
You’re too called to stay where you are.
You don’t fully enjoy sin anymore…
But you’re not fully surrendered either.
So you live in this exhausting middle.

Church on Sunday.
Compromise in private.

Worship with your lips…
War in your mind.
Because you were never created to live divided.
“No one can serve two masters…” — Matthew 6:24
You feel the tension because your soul was made for truth.
And now God is doing something uncomfortable…
People you relied on… are shifting.
Things that once satisfied you… are losing their power.
“The Lord directs the steps of the righteous.” — Proverbs 16:9
God will shut down what’s slowly destroying you.
Even if you don’t understand it in the moment.
Because your comfort is not His priority.
You feel it when you wake up.
You feel it late at night.
You feel it in random moments when everything else fades.
You suddenly want to pray again.
You think about reading the Bible again.

“After what you did?”
“You think God still wants you?”
“You’ve gone too far this time.”
And so instead of running to God…
“There is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” — Romans 8:1
And some of you have been listening to the wrong voice.
But that is not the end of your story.
Because this is where everything changes.
Not when you get your life together.
“All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
That includes every person who has ever lived.
“For the wages of sin is death…” — Romans 6:23
“…but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.” — Romans 6:23
Jesus didn’t come for the perfect.
“God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
Not when you fixed your habits.
While you were still in it.
Defeating the very thing that’s been holding you captive.
“Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out…” — Acts 3:19
Repentance is not just saying sorry.
You don’t have to keep living like this.
God is not asking for perfection.
Because the fact that you’re reading this?
The fact that you feel this?
The fact that something inside you is stirring?
You don’t need a perfect prayer.

“Lord… I’ve been running.
I’ve been hiding.
I’ve been choosing my way over Yours.

Forgive me.
Change me.
Lead me.
I surrender my life to You.
From hiding to healing. From shame to salvation. Because Jesus still restores.
